x: Other notable performances were by Brian Nott(9th) in his first run as a second-claim member, John Bicourt (11th) still a youth and Mike Coningham(15th) our South African member who was having his first outing at Belgrave.

Belgravians will be interested to know that Mike Coningham was 13th and Rex Chugg - a former Australian member - was also competing. Rex's brother Doug is now back in Australia running his own business but finds little time for training.

The name of BELGRAVE HARRIERS was not new to him either, for in Johannesburg he shared a flat with former member Mike CONINGHAM (resident at Lauriston Cottage for some time) who also made the Springbok's team..
